package.welcome_message: Welcome to a 4-day Jordan adventure featuring Amman, Wadi Rum, and Aqaba - curated with authentic Jordanian experiences.

trip.title: Amman · Wadi Rum · Aqaba
trip.summary: Four days of cultural heritage, desert landscapes, and coastal charm. Each day is anchored in a single region, with morning walks in the heat-prone desert and afternoon shade for museums, meals, or relaxation.

planning.strategy: Each day stays in one area: Wadi Rum (2 days), then Aqaba. Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon. About 3 places to visit and 3 meals on exploring days. The arrival day follows the time that remains after food and rest.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Each day stays in one area
decisions.why: Mixing far-apart cities in one day makes the trip exhausting and confusing.
decisions.effect: Your days follow Wadi Rum (2 days), then Aqaba.

decisions.title: This trip stays in one part of Jordan
decisions.why: 3 exploring days is too short for both the north and the south.
decisions.effect: So this journey focuses on the south, and those places get proper time.

decisions.title: Your first night is near the airport
decisions.effect: Night one is a hotel in Amman. Exploring starts from there the next day.

decisions.title: Amman for the first night, then south
decisions.why: You land at Queen Alia, and the exploring days are in Southern Jordan.
decisions.effect: Stay in Amman on arrival night, then travel south the next day.

decisions.title: A quiet first night
decisions.effect: Transfer, a simple dinner if kitchens are open, then sleep. Exploring starts tomorrow.

decisions.title: Day trips from one hotel
decisions.why: These places are close enough to visit and return the same day.
decisions.effect: You keep the same hotel in Wadi Rum and come back there to sleep.

decisions.title: Then you move closer to the places you came for
decisions.why: Sleeping in the same city you visit beats a long commute every morning.
decisions.effect: After the arrival night, nearby days share one hotel. You only move when the next area is too far for a day trip.

decisions.title: Your must-see places get proper time
decisions.effect: Those places are locked in first. Extra days go to the regions you asked to explore.

decisions.title: Mornings for the outdoors
decisions.why: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
decisions.effect: Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon.

decisions.title: A balanced pace
decisions.effect: About 3 places to visit and 3 meals on exploring days. The arrival day follows the time that remains after food and rest.

decisions.title: 3 star stays
decisions.effect: Hotels are taken from listings at that star level when the city has them. If it does not, we use the closest listed tier and say so.

decisions.title: A comfort budget
decisions.effect: We lean toward more comfortable stays and dining when those places exist.

decisions.title: Chosen around what you care about
decisions.effect: Sights, meals, and local hosts are matched to these. Unrelated places stay out.

days.summary: Late arrival in Amman: eat if you can, then sleep. Exploring starts tomorrow.

schedule.name: InterContinental Jordan
schedule.description: Long-established five-star IHG hotel on Islamic College Street in Jabal Amman, between the Second and Third Circles, with six restaurants, indoor and outdoor pools, a spa and a 24-hour reception.
schedule.reason: Check in and sleep. Sightseeing starts tomorrow. 5-star stay, as requested

days.transport_notes: You land at 21:53. The drive from Queen Alia to Amman is about 45 minutes. Times below start after that transfer.

days.summary: Morning desert exploration of Lawrence's Spring, French Fortress Ruins, and Al-Khazali petroglyphs, followed by lunch and a sunset dinner.

schedule.name: Rahayeb Desert Camp Restaurant
schedule.description: Bedouin camp dining area set against sandstone cliffs in protected Wadi Rum valley.
schedule.reason: Breakfast before the morning walk.

schedule.name: Lawrence's Spring
schedule.description: A natural mountain spring associated with T.E. Lawrence's desert travels.
schedule.reason: Historic site in the desert, a must-see for history lovers.

schedule.name: French Fortress Ruins (Wadi Rum)
schedule.description: Stone fort ruins built as a movie set for the French cinema production 'Le Premier Corde'.
schedule.reason: Historic film set and desert architecture.

schedule.name: Al-Khazali Mountain Petroglyphs
schedule.description: Extensive concentration of ancient Thamudic and Safaitic petroglyphs carved on Jebel Khazali cliffs.
schedule.reason: Iconic rock art site, a highlight of Wadi Rum.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Bedouin Night Camp Restaurant
schedule.description: Secluded desert camp dining space serving authentic Bedouin meals.
schedule.reason: Lunch in the shade of the desert.

schedule.name: Nabataean Temple of Wadi Rum
schedule.description: Stone ruins of a 1st-century BC Nabataean temple dedicated to goddess Allat near Rum Village.
schedule.reason: Historic religious site, complementing the morning walk.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Anfeeshiah Inscriptions
schedule.description: Large vertical cliff wall decorated with ancient Thamudic petroglyphs and camel caravans.
schedule.reason: Additional rock art to enrich the desert experience.

schedule.name: Rum Magic Restaurant
schedule.description: Authentic Bedouin dining experience serving traditional Zarb near Wadi Rum entrance.
schedule.reason: Dinner with a desert backdrop.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

days.transport_notes: This evening you check in to your hotel in Wadi Rum.

days.summary: Morning canyon trekking and historic sites, followed by a scenic lunch and an evening desert dinner.

schedule.name: Wadi Rum Rest House Restaurant
schedule.description: Historic entrance hub eatery in Wadi Rum Village offering simple local meals and drinks.
schedule.reason: Breakfast before the day's adventures.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Khazali Canyon
schedule.description: Narrow fissure canyon in Jebel Khazali famous for ancient Thamudic, Anati, and Nabataean petroglyphs.
schedule.reason: Iconic canyon walk, a highlight of Wadi Rum.

schedule.name: Desert Police Station & Fort (Wadi Rum)
schedule.description: Active stone desert patrol fort in Rum Village staffed by traditional Jordan Desert Patrol officers.
schedule.reason: Historic fort, a quick cultural stop.
matched_preferences: A second day to go beyond the main site
One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Red Sand Dunes of Wadi Rum
schedule.description: High red sand dunes leaning against sandstone cliffs in central Wadi Rum.
schedule.reason: Scenic dune walk, a must-see for desert lovers.

schedule.name: Lawrence's House
schedule.description: Stone ruins of a Nabataean structure associated with T.E. Lawrence's military stay.
schedule.reason: Historic site linked to the famous desert legend.

schedule.name: Captain's Desert Camp Restaurant
schedule.description: Desert camp dining venue in Disah offering authentic Bedouin Zarb feasts and live entertainment.
schedule.reason: Lunch in the desert, a cultural experience.

schedule.name: Barrah Canyon
schedule.description: 5-kilometer long majestic sandstone canyon favored for desert trekking and rock climbing.
schedule.reason: Extended canyon trek for a deeper desert immersion.
matched_preferences: A second day to go beyond the main site

schedule.name: Seven Pillars of Wisdom Mountain
schedule.description: Multi-turreted granite sandstone mountain structure facing the Wadi Rum Visitor Center.
schedule.reason: Iconic viewpoint, a quick stop before dinner.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Hasan Zawaideh Camp Dining
schedule.description: Authentic Bedouin camp restaurant in the red sand valley featuring daily Zarb feasts.
schedule.reason: Dinner with a desert ambiance.

days.transport_notes: This evening you check in to your hotel in Wadi Rum.

days.summary: Morning beach club breakfast, followed by historic sites and a seaside lunch.

schedule.name: Ayla Beach Club Restaurant
schedule.description: Chic beach club restaurant on B12 Lagoon in Ayla, serving Mediterranean salads, stone-baked pizzas, and cocktails.
schedule.reason: Breakfast with a sea view to start the day.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Ancient Aqaba Church
schedule.description: Ruins of the world's oldest purpose-built Christian church.
schedule.reason: Historic landmark, a must-see for history enthusiasts.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: King Hussein Bin Talal Mosque
schedule.description: Grand central mosque with a striking dome and four minarets.
schedule.reason: Architectural highlight of Aqaba.
matched_preferences: One visit covering the nearby monuments

schedule.name: Berenice Beach Club Restaurant Aqaba
schedule.description: Coastal beach club on Aqaba's South Beach offering grills, wood-fired pizza, and Red Sea views.
schedule.reason: Lunch with a seaside view.

schedule.name: Ayla Oasis Marina
schedule.description: Modern waterfront development with lagoons, dining, and promenades.
schedule.reason: Scenic walk along the marina, a relaxing finish to the day.

days.transport_notes: Come back to your hotel in Wadi Rum to sleep.
